text: Sarah thought she was adding a little kick to her cookies, but instead, she created a culinary mystery that left her friends reaching for milk with every bite. It turns out she mistook sugar for salt, resulting in a batch of "sweet and salty surprise" cookies that were less of a treat and more of a hydration challenge. As for the tool used for writing? Well, since the text is filled with those weird little hats (^) between every word, I’d say the tool was a very confused keyboard or perhaps a glitchy autocorrect feature that really needed a break.
